source.trvl_flights.note: Google Flights, Kiwi and Skiplagged. Baggage filters (carry_on_bags/checked_bags) enable all_in_cost (final price incl. baggage) per fare.
source.fli_flights.note: Second engine (Google Flights direct). Returns 0 results for some routes; the runner tolerates this (status ok, 0 offers).
source.skiplagged_flights.note: Meta search; prices in USD (converted only with a documented rate). The response is sometimes structured, sometimes only a Markdown table, hence fallback extraction.
source.rome_hotel_taxes.note: Google Hotels source with tax-inclusive total and itemised tax/fee lines per OTA channel (Booking/Agoda/Hostelworld). booking.com is not queried (no WAF).
source.skiplagged_hotels.note: Enable once the server responds (during registry creation it returned 0 tools or timeouts for Rome); taxesAndFeesInDollars was null.
source.maqami-travel.note: The only keyless flight server so far that itemises taxes/fees: pricing.display = {base, taxes, fees, total}. total is the final price incl. tax for ALL passengers (1 adult 369.25 EUR / 2 adults 738.50 EUR).
source.octotrip-flights.note: EUR as default currency (no conversion needed); price = total trip price for all passengers, results[].baggage states the baggage. Note: blocks curl user-agents, rate limit 1 rps, valid for ~15 min.
source.callstay.note: rooms[].total_all_in = final price incl. taxes/fees; rooms[].fees[] with description/amount/included_in_total and due_at_property. Search then price_stay. Hosted registry com.callstay/hotels v0.1.0 (no open source).
source.alice-flights.note: Direct REST search (El Al/Israir network). Prices in USD, totalPrice = total trip price for all passengers. No tax field.
source.flights-gf.note: Google Flights scraper as MCP. Tool documentation: "Prices are totals for all passengers".
source.pilotplans-hotels.note: Coordinates, stars and a cancellation flag per rate; note: search in EUR, rates in USD (the currency changes between search and rate request).
source.bookresorts.note: total_price_usd per provider: "stay totals in USD with taxes & fees" (no separate tax field). The currency is encoded in the field name.
source.maqami-travel-hotels.note: Second keyless server with explicit hotel taxes: rates[].retailRate.total[].amount (total) and taxesAndFees[].amount with an included flag per item (e.g. "RESORT", included=false). One call returns hotel, rates and cancellation terms.
source.googleflights-local.note: Local stdio scraper (own IP, no shared-IP ban, no key). Same data basis as flights-gf, but usable independently if that source fails.
source.easygroupflights.note: Response is plain text, not JSON, so parser: text. Tool documentation: "Prices are per person". Slovak OTA; offers valid for 30 minutes, no tax field.
source.ferryhopper_mcp.note: Prices in cents (expectedPrice.totalPriceInCents), per person; cabin classes per cabin. Verified live: Barcelona-Palma 3668 = 36.68 EUR.
source.trvl_ferries.note: trvl router (search_ground, type=ferry), keyless. Price = 1 adult without vehicle; only "ferryhopper" is live, DFDS/Viking/Eckerö give reference prices. Licence PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (non-commercial).
source.finnlines_ferry.note: Finnlines booking GraphQL (AWS AppSync), keyless via the public SPA client key, live. chargeTotal = total per passenger (1 adult 17.60 EUR); ports are Finnlines codes (FINLI, SEKPS ...), not city names. Browser user-agent required.
source.stays_hotels.note: Google Hotels. currency=USD is the default, so currency is mandatory. includes_taxes_and_fees is a dead switch in the package (never true).
source.hal-cruises.note: Holland America Line, public search, no key. Price = cheapest cabin fare (RESTRICTED) per person in EUR incl. taxes/fees (taxExpenses_EUR = tax share); sortPrice_EUR is the FLEXIBLE fare, not the cheapest.
source.rcl-cruises.note: Royal Caribbean/Celebrity, public JSON APIs (no key). price = cabin price per person WITHOUT taxes; all_in = price per person INCLUDING taxes; drinks_included=false = drinks not included. Scales linearly with passengers.
source.hal-price-api.note: Cabin-level prices per HAL cruise: bestAvailable.price (final, incl. taxes), .basePrice (without taxes), .tax, .classification. Needs {cruise_id} from hal-cruises: a follow-up, not a standalone search.
